def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    # find border box of 5s
    rows=[i for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]

    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)

    marks=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (0,5)]
